theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks to Fall on AI, Key US Yield Tops 5%: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks were set to decline after a selloff in US semiconductor shares as concerns grew that the pace of artificial intelligence development may slow. Inflation worries briefly pushed the 10-year Treasury yield above 5% for the first time since 2023.

top_news.title: Asian Junk Debt Is Beating Returns on Bonds Almost Everywhere
top_news.summary: Asian high-yield debt has emerged as a surprising global winner in bond markets as ever-cheaper money in China burnishes issuer finances.

top_news.title: Samsung Faces Local Hedge Fund’s Push to Cancel Preferred Shares
top_news.summary: A South Korean hedge fund is urging Samsung Electronics Co. to buy back and cancel preferred shares, becoming one of the first shareholders to directly press for the step in hopes of boosting valuation.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 15
top_news.summary: Oil edged higher as traders weighed risks to Middle East supplies, with a critical Saudi Arabian pipeline still offline after an attack.

top_news.title: Authentic Brands Targets Creator Economy, Eyes Public Offering
top_news.summary: Authentic Brands Group, a licensor of everything from Elvis Presley’s image to the Reebok sportswear brand, could pursue an initial public stock offering as early as the first half of next year.

top_news.title: Teva CEO on Shares Trading Directly on the NYSE
top_news.summary: Teva Pharmaceuticals President & CEO Richard Francis, discusses why Teva chose to make the change now and what will be different for investors as the shares move from ADRs to direct NYSE trading. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Boomer Candy Leads To Boomer Cavities: Huszczo
top_news.summary: Sam Huszczo, founder & CIO of SGH Wealth Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss how investors might be getting a bit overconfident amid this bull market. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Apollo’s Michaels Uses $101 Million of Tariff Refund to Cut Debt
top_news.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc.-owned retailer Michaels Cos. used a windfall from tariff refunds to help cut its leverage, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_news.title: Crafting America’s Countertops is Killing Workers
top_news.summary: Silicosis is an incurable workplace disease. Countertop fabrication workers around the country who have contracted the illness are suing the artificial stone industry for billions. However, while California weighs a ban on the product, the manufacturers’ defenders in Congress are trying to ban the lawsuits. Josh Eidelson explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Tema Rolls 'DICE' On SpaceX, Prediction Markets
top_news.summary:
Paisley Nardini, head of investment strategy at Tema ETFs, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss Tema Trading & Prediction Markets ETF (ticker: DICE) and Tema Space Innovators ETF (ticker: NASA). 

 (Source: Bloomberg)
